_comment: Every refusal code an agent or SDK can receive, per surface. The Rust proxy (packages/proxy/src/refusal.rs), both clawde SDKs (PROXY_REFUSALS), both gate SDKs (GATE_REFUSAL_CODES), the MCP proxy (MCP_REFUSAL_CODES), the hook gates' JSON decisions (HOOK_REFUSAL_CODES in the sync daemon's gateBody.ts), the reference tables in apps/docs and the Kitkat skill are each checked against this file. Add a code here first, then to every implementation the checks name.

refusals.meaning: A policy, anomaly detector or custom WASM rule blocked the request
The model is not on the approved-models list
The loop run this request belongs to has stopped
The loop run is paused until a reviewer approves or rejects it
A Rego or WASM rule held the request for approval; the error names the hold id
Revise the approach and try again; repeated attempts escalate to `policy_denied`

A governance check could not complete. Either a custom WASM or Rego rule reached no verdict (its deadline, its instruction budget, an error, or a result that is not a verdict): refused whatever the proxy's fail setting, and refused again if the same request is retried, the message naming the rule. Or, with the proxy failing closed, the workspace's PII detector setting could not be read
A hard spend budget covering the request (the workspace's, the virtual key's or its member's) does not cover its estimated cost; `error.budget` names it and `Retry-After` says when it resets
The plan's daily spend cap is reached and the workspace has it set to block
The virtual key's requests-per-minute or tokens-per-minute limit is reached; `Retry-After` says when the next minute starts
The request's estimated cost is over the workspace threshold: 402 on a stream, a 200 answer otherwise
The request contains content the DLP policy blocks
The model called a tool an SOP denies to this agent role; the call was withheld
The model called a tool the workspace's SSO group policy does not clear for this member; the call was withheld
The model called a shell tool to run destructive SQL against a database the SQL allowlist does not admit; the call was withheld
The model's response did not parse while a tool policy was in force, so it was withheld; retrying may succeed
The model's response held sensitive content that could not be redacted safely, so it was withheld
The workspace's SSO group policy does not clear this tool for the member, or the member's groups are unknown
A block rule in the policy snapshot matched
A hold rule matched: the call is held for a person's approval, and `holdId` names the hold
The MCP server is blocked in the MCP server registry
The MCP server changed its tools in a way scored high risk and waits for an owner or admin to approve it again
The workspace refuses MCP servers it has not approved (`mcpDefaultPolicy: deny`), and this one is not approved
The tool is switched off on this MCP server in the registry
The MCP server is not on the workspace's `mcpAllowedServers` list
The policy snapshot on this machine failed its integrity check, so it admits no MCP server; the sync daemon restores the last verified snapshot
A block rule in the SOP register matched
The control plane's hook gate refused the call, or could not be reached while `failClosed` is on
The command is over 256 KiB, or the tool arguments over 1 MiB, the most a gate evaluates; split the work into smaller calls
A deploy uses an image tagged `latest`
A deploy uses an image by tag where the allowlist requires a digest
A deploy uses an image from a registry the allowlist does not name
A deploy uses an image the allowlist does not name
A deploy uses an image digest the allowlist does not approve
The image allowlist, or a manifest the deploy names, is missing or unreadable
The Workflow DevKit adapter was called inside the workflow sandbox, where the gate cannot run; run it in a step
The Workflow DevKit adapter has no gate to call: none was passed and none was installed
A rule built into the hook gate matched: a governance bypass, a write to a protected path or a skill directory, or a secret in written content
A block rule in the policy snapshot matched: an SOP, the destructive-command tier or a skill-content rule
The workspace's SSO group policy does not clear this tool for the member, or the member's groups are unknown
A hold rule matched: the call is held for a person's approval, and `holdId` names the hold
The MCP server is blocked in the MCP server registry
The MCP server changed its tools in a way scored high risk and waits for an owner or admin to approve it again
The workspace refuses MCP servers it has not approved (`mcpDefaultPolicy: deny`), and this one is not approved
The tool is switched off on this MCP server in the registry
The MCP server is not on the workspace's `mcpAllowedServers` list
The policy snapshot on this machine failed its integrity check, so it admits no MCP server; the sync daemon restores the last verified snapshot
The command is over 256 KiB, or the tool arguments over 1 MiB, the most a gate evaluates; split the work into smaller calls
The gate did not finish deciding within its deadline, a second under its harness's hook timeout and at most 9 seconds, and refuses rather than let the hook timeout allow the call
The hook received no tool call it could read, and refuses rather than allow a call it cannot evaluate
The gate failed while deciding, and refuses rather than allow an unevaluated call
The MCP server registry has not loaded since the proxy started, and the proxy fails closed
The server is blocked in the MCP server registry
The server changed its tools in a way scored high risk and waits for an owner or admin to approve it again
The workspace refuses servers it has not approved (`mcpDefaultPolicy: deny`), and this one is not approved
The tool is switched off on this server in the registry
The server is not on the workspace's `mcpAllowedServers` list
The tool is not on the workspace's `mcpAllowedTools` list
The workspace's SSO group policy does not clear this tool for the member, or the member's groups are unknown
The arguments contain a credential, a destructive command or a PII value the DLP scan blocks
A `block` SOP rule matched
A `require_approval` SOP rule matched: the call is held for a person's approval, and `holdId` names the hold
The arguments matched a prompt-injection pattern, and the workspace blocks injection
An anomaly detector stopped the call
A custom WASM or Rego rule blocked the call
An anomaly detector or WASM rule refused this attempt; revise the approach
The same detector or rule refused three attempts, so it now blocks outright
An MCP call budget covering this call is used up until `resetAt`
A call budget covers this call but could not be checked, and the proxy fails closed

A governance check could not complete; the reason names it. When the control plane's policy, the PII setting or the DLP scan was unavailable, the proxy refused because it fails closed (`mcpProxyFailBehavior`). When a custom WASM or Rego rule reached no verdict (its deadline, its budget, an error, a result that is not a verdict, or the rule quarantined after three runaways), the call is refused whatever the fail setting, and refused again if retried with the same input
The server's pinned tool definitions could not be read or written, and the proxy fails closed
The server's tool definitions changed since they were first pinned, and the proxy fails closed
The tool ran, but its result held sensitive data that could not be redacted safely, so it was not delivered
The tool ran, but its result matched a prompt-injection pattern, so it was not delivered
